name: seekstone
description: Obsidian MCP server — filesystem-direct vault access, low context-tax.

vault.title: Obsidian vault
vault.description: Your Obsidian vault folder. To find it: open Obsidian → click the vault icon (bottom-left) → Manage vaults, or go to Settings → About. On macOS, vaults are typically in ~/Documents, ~/Desktop, or ~/Obsidian. On Windows, usually in C:\Users\<you>\Documents.

read_only.title: Read-only
read_only.description: Remove the write tools so the session can't change your vault. Default: off.

read_paths.title: Read paths
read_paths.description: Comma-separated vault-relative globs the agent may see, e.g. Projects/** or !Journal/**. Writes are limited to them too. Default: blank, the whole vault.

write_paths.title: Write paths
write_paths.description: Comma-separated vault-relative globs where writes are allowed, e.g. journal/**,inbox/*.md. Default: blank, writes allowed anywhere.

history.title: Write history
history.description: Keep a copy of each file before a write so undo_write can restore it. Default: on.

history_max_size.title: History size cap
history_max_size.description: Cap on stored pre-write copies, e.g. 100mb. Past it the oldest copies are deleted. Default: blank, 50 MB.

history_max_entries.title: History entry cap
history_max_entries.description: Most write-history entries to keep. Past it the oldest are deleted and can't be undone. Default: 1000.

log_level.title: Log level
log_level.description: error, warn, info or debug. Default: info.

log_file.title: Log file
log_file.description: Absolute path of a file to append JSON-line logs to. Default: blank, logs go to Claude Desktop's log only.

log_max_size.title: Log size cap
log_max_size.description: Rotate the log file past this size, e.g. 10mb. Default: blank, 5 MB.

audit_file.title: Audit file
audit_file.description: Absolute path of a file that gets one JSON line per write-tool call, never note content. Default: blank, no audit file.

audit_max_size.title: Audit size cap
audit_max_size.description: Rotate the audit file past this size, e.g. 10mb. Default: blank, 10 MB.

instructions.title: Instructions file
instructions.description: A file whose text is sent to Claude as the server's instructions, up to 16 KB. Default: none.

watch_poll.title: Poll for changes
watch_poll.description: Check files on a timer instead of OS change events. Turn on for network drives or WSL. Default: off.

watch_poll_interval.title: Poll interval (ms)
watch_poll_interval.description: How often to check files when polling is on, in milliseconds. Default: 10000.
